Name: Asarelah, Son of Asaph
Summary: Son of Asaph who prophesied under the hands of Asaph.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 25:2: Son of Asaph who prophesied under the hands of Asaph.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Asarelah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
